title: Ledup pill button
description: A soft pill with the label and a small up-right arrow. Solid: translucent taupe with white text that darkens on hover. Outline: a thin ink outline that fills taupe with white text on hover (0.12s).
notes: solid reads on photos and light pages; outline is for light pages
name: ledup-button

props.description: show the small up-right arrow after the label
